title: ChatGPT for iOS Updates - June 9, 2026
description: Codex iOS app 1.2026.153 added support for choosing branches, creating worktrees, running environment setup scripts, new Codex profile screen with usage stats, /goal support for mobile, inline review comments, and side chat from selected transcript text.

title: Canvas Design Mode and Context Usage Report
description: Design Mode is now available in canvases for faster editing. Cursor can also display context usage as an interactive canvas report, breaking down token usage across system prompts, tools, rules, and skills.

title: Organizations for Cursor Enterprise
description: Enterprise customers can now manage multiple Cursor teams from one organization with separate security, governance, budget, and feature controls. Includes organizations, teams, and groups hierarchy with granular permissions.

title: Auto-Review Run Mode
description: New Auto-Review run mode allows Cursor to work longer with fewer approval prompts. A classifier subagent decides which tool calls run automatically, which to sandbox, and which to require human approval. Configurable via Settings and permissions.json.

community_feedback.quote: Auto mode is now usage-based (already hit $7)
Is Cursor more expensive than using Claude Code (June 2026)?

title: GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex Models Deprecated
description: GitHub deprecated GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex models for Copilot users as part of the June 2026 update cycle.

title: Activity Insights and Share Cards
description: Codex app 26.602 added activity insights and shareable profile cards in the Profile section. Users can review Codex usage highlights and share profile cards on consumer ChatGPT plans.

title: Fix with Copilot for Failing Actions
description: New 'Fix with Copilot' feature for failing GitHub Actions is now available in Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max tiers, allowing AI-assisted debugging of workflow failures.

title: Visual Studio and VS Code May/June Updates
description: GitHub released Copilot updates for Visual Studio (May update) and Visual Studio Code with Copilot Chat bringing richer context to pull requests.

title: Design Mode Improvements with Multi-Select and Voice Input
description: Cursor enhanced Design Mode with multi-select elements, voice input capabilities, and improved component styling. Users can now click multiple elements simultaneously, narrate changes by voice, and queue new instructions while agents are running.

title: SDK Updates: Custom Tools, Auto-Review, and Nested Subagents
description: Cursor SDK now supports custom tools, auto-review routing for safer headless execution, JSONL and custom stores for persistence, and nested subagents. Both TypeScript and Python SDKs received reliability and performance improvements.

title: June 2026 Release Wave - Copilot Enhancements
description: GitHub released multiple Copilot updates in early June 2026, including larger context windows with configurable reasoning levels, Copilot Chat improvements for pull requests, and the general availability of Enterprise Teams. Additional updates include agent tasks REST API for Copilot Pro tiers, budget and usage management APIs, and billing usage reports API.

community_feedback.quote: As per the tool my usage as per April 2026 usage will cost me USD$519.26. This is pretty expensive and not at all affordable.
End of an Era - GitHub Copilot is moving to usage-based billing on June 1, 2026.

title: Copilot SDK Generally Available
description: The Copilot SDK became generally available in June 2026, providing developers with programmatic access to Copilot capabilities.

title: Sites Preview - Build and Deploy Websites
description: Sites is now available in preview in the Codex app. Users can create, save, deploy, and inspect websites, dashboards, internal tools, web apps, and games hosted by OpenAI. Included in ChatGPT Business workspaces and available to ChatGPT Enterprise via RBAC.

community_feedback.quote: Two Codex updates landed June 2, 2026: Sites preview in the Codex app - Codex can now create, save, deploy, and inspect websites, dashboards.

title: iOS App Updates - Face ID Lock and Windows SSH Support
description: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.146 added optional Face ID/passcode lock for Codex, new settings screen for Queue/Steer behavior, and support for connecting to Windows machines over SSH.

title: Claude Opus 4.8 Released
description: Claude Opus 4.8 was released as the new default model for Max/Team plans, showing improvements over Opus 4.7 in coding with notable security enhancements.

community_feedback.quote: Lots of people want to try Claude Opus 4.8
Discussion about Claude Code potentially being called Opus, with a note about CLI stopping working from June 18, 2026

title: Amazon Bedrock Model Provider Support
description: Codex can now use supported OpenAI models available through Amazon Bedrock. Configure Amazon Bedrock as the model provider to run Codex locally with AWS-managed authentication, account controls, and billing.

title: Terminal Placement Controls
description: Codex app 26.601 added Default terminal location setting. When bottom panel is enabled, users can choose whether terminal shortcuts open in bottom panel or right panel.

title: Week 22 Updates - v2.1.150 to v2.1.157
description: Multiple releases during May 25-29, 2026 including improvements to rendering performance for large file writes (v2.1.169 mentioned), and ongoing iterative updates to the Claude Code tooling.
